# Notification scheduler cleanup uses different listener functions from registration

Fixed waitForActive registers activate with callback and resize/MozUpdateWindowPos with debounceCallback. Its cleanup removes activate with handleUnload and resize/MozUpdateWindowPos with callback. These are different function objects, so the shown removal calls do not remove those installed listeners. A proposed focused lifecycle test should settle/cancel a wait, fire each old event and check that its callback/timer cannot run again. This is a static callback-identity gap, not a reproduced leak or claim all cleanup is absent. Full earlier D239335 discussion remains unavailable. This is a public source-only scoped investigation/test proposal, not an accepted new rule or executed failure.

Scope: In-app notification scheduler cancellation and resource lifetime.
